## Contribution checklist

- [ ] My contribution commits have matching DCO `Signed-off-by` trailers (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] My contribution commits have GitHub-verified signatures (`git commit -S`).
- [ ] I ran relevant local checks and added appropriate tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] I updated affected guides, examples and the documentation index.
- [ ] I checked that no credentials, private deployment settings or learner data are included.
- [ ] I reviewed the [contribution and merge requirements](https://github.com/OSSAfrica/funkwiz/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
